gloss: to be rich in, to abound in

definitions.gloss: to be rich in, to abound in, to be abundant
definitions.explanation: To possess something in large quantity or to be well-endowed with a particular quality. Often used with the particle に to indicate what is abundant.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{富|と}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This land is rich in nature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{富|と}んだ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to consult someone rich in experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鉱物|こうぶつ}→鉱物：04149_koubutsu⟧⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{富|と}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This region is known for being rich in mineral resources.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Almost always used in the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form ({富|と}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧) to describe an ongoing state of abundance. The pattern is X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{富|と}む (to be rich in X).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{富|と}む — rich in experience
- ⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{富|と}む — full of variety
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{富|と}む — rich in talent
- ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{富|と}む — rich in nutrition
- ⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{富|と}む — rich in resources

USAGE:
{富|と}む is primarily used in written and formal contexts. In everyday speech, ⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧な is more common to express the same idea (e.g., ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧).
